en: ...Yes, I suppose it is.

Phew. Well, that's it for Love to See You Smile, but we
still have one more job to do.
Yes, it's a quiz program⑬Sotenbori Love Check Quiz.

Let me guess⑬to maintain the quirky image, you have to get
the answers wrong, is that right?

Yes, that's right. The agency told me I must not answer
correctly.
They don't make it easy for you, do they?

The quiz is made up of true or false questions. If I'm to
answer incorrectly, I'll need to know which answer is
actually correct.
Okay, I get that.

I'll need you to guide me with cue cards again. Will you
please help me?
Of course. I'm right behind you.

Here's your dressing room. Should I be using cue cards
during the quiz so you can stay in character?

Oh, yes, please. I'm still struggling to accept the
character I'm supposed to be...
Yeah, that's understandable.
Excuse me. Strawberry Maya-san, we're ready for you.
Oh, yes!
I'll show you to the Love to See You Smile studio.
Huh? Wasn't it the quiz show?

Hm? No, Love to See You Smile comes first. That's how we
scheduled things with Dyna Chair.
Uh... Right. Love to See You Smile comes first.
Huh!? Akiyama-san...

Sorry, totally my bad. Luckily, the shows are recorded in
the same building, so we're safe.

(Nice going, idiot. Maya-chan's probably losing faith in you
by the second.)

This seems to be your dressing room. I guess we're just
supposed to wait here?
I don't know. I guess?
Hm? Come in.
Um, excuse me, are you Strawberry Maya-san?
Yes, that's me.

I noticed you coming in, but you're really early. Are you
sure you got your times right?
Huh? Really? That's odd.
Akiyama-san, did you maybe get the schedule mixed up?
...I might have.

But that would be a disaster! We could be missing
appointments!

(She has three jobs today. If it's not the quiz, it's either
Love to See You Smile or the magazine interview.)
(What was her first job?)

(She has three jobs today. If it's not Love to See You
Smile, it's either the quiz show or the magazine
interview.)
That's right. We're here for Love to See You Smile.

Uh, Love to See You Smile is recorded here, too, but you're
really early for that, as well.
So, uh... we're supposed to be at the magazine interview?
But... that means the interviewer's waiting for us!

Well, mistakes happen. We can still make it. The interview's
scheduled at Dyna Chair. Let's go.
Oh, yes! Please.
That's right. We're here for Sotenbori Love Check Quiz.

Uh, Sotenbori Love Check Quiz is recorded here, too, but
you're really early for that, as well.

Right, we're supposed to be at the magazine interview. We
have to get to Dyna Chair.

Are you the manager? What kept you? I thought we'd arranged
time in advance!
Ah, I'm terribly sorry. There was a mix-up on my end.

Oh, for crying out loud! You know, this is the first time
I've ever had this happen. You need to get your act together
as her manager!

You're absolutely justified in your anger. I'll make sure it
never happens again.

Please do! Sheesh... Okay, that's enough of that. Let's get
on with the interview.
I'm Asano with Beginner Magazine.

(Now he calms down... This manager thing's tougher than I
thought.)
Hello, I'm Asano with Beginner Magazine.

We're a talent audition news magazine. Today, we're hoping
to delve a little into Maya-chan's private life.
Oui! Nice to meet you, paloomp!

So... Strawberry Maya-chan comes as advertised. Are you
always like that, even when you're not on TV?

But of course, paloomp! Maya is the princess of the
Strawberry Kingdom, after all!
...Uh, yes. Yes, you are. Forgive me.

(Wow, Maya-chan's really laying it on thick. She's normally
so sincere and serious, too. It must be tough for her to
keep it up.)

(I can't let her effort go to waste. I have to make sure I
get her cue cards right.)

(She says "paloomp" when she's happy, "pon" when she's
angry, and "foonyapar" if she's stuck for an answer.)

Maya-chan, can you tell us how you spend your holidays? What
does someone like you do on their time off?

Hmm, Maya can't do without her strawberry carriage. She just
loves taking it out for long drives!
Her strawberry carriage? What is that?

The strawberry carriage is a giant strawberry drawn by white
stallions. The premise is...
I'm sorry... Did you just say premise?
Oh, uh, um...

(Off to a great start, I see... Okay, here's where I come in
with the cue cards. What should I write?)

(Okay, Maya-chan, read this. "I didn't say that,
mambo!")
I didn't say that, mambo!

Maya-chan, I'm a little surprised by that response. You seem
somewhat different from the girl I see on TV.
Uh, well, actually, I...
Foonyapar!

Ahaha! Yes! There it is! Foonyapar! I love that bit,
Maya-chan.

(I must have screwed up. Maya-chan said she didn't want to
foonyapar unless she had to.)

(How did it go again? "Paloomp" when she's happy, "pon" when
she's angry, and "foonyapar" if she's stuck for an answer.)
(Okay, Maya-chan, read this. "Maya didn't say that, pon!")
Maya didn't say that, pon!

Is that so? I'm pretty certain I heard you say the word
"premise."
Did not, pon!
Oh... Well, if you say so.

(She managed to tough it out. I guess this is how I'm
supposed to support her.)
(Okay, Maya-chan, read this. "Silence, paloomp!")
Silence, paloomp!

Huh? Maya-chan, don't you only add "paloomp" at the end of
sentences when you're happy?
That's what was written in your agency's official profile.
Uh, er, well...

(How did it go again? "Paloomp" when she's happy, "pon" when
angry, and "foonyapar" if she's stuck for an answer.)
Uh, Maya-chan? What was that you said about "the premise"?

This will be the final question. We received credible
reports that you're actually from Osaka, Maya-chan. Would
you care to comment?

So not true! Maya is the princess of Strawberry Kingdom,
pon!

There are photos circulating online that are purportedly of
you from your junior high yearbook. Were you aware of that?
Pardon? Is that true?
(This doesn't look good...)

I went to the school and spoke with one of your teachers.
She said that you were a timid, but rather thoughtful and
considerate student.
Uh, well, you see...

Let me ask you straight⑬is it hard to keep up the
Strawberry Maya-chan character? Don't worry, this can be off
the record.

(This interviewer's not playing nice. Maya needs a cue card.
But what should I write?)

(All right, Maya-chan, read this. "Playing this character is
hard.")

Well, yes. It is challenging playing such a perky
character all the time...

Ohh... So, the rumors were true. You really are a quiet and
thoughtful person?
I'd like to think so...

I suspected as much, but your revelation does come as a bit
of a shock. You were just this made-up cartoon character
after all.

(I steered her wrong. Maya-chan's looking a little
defeated...)
(All right, Maya-chan, read this. "Maya isn't acting, pon!")
Maya isn't acting, pon!

Uh... Okay. You know, Maya-chan, I have to hand it to you
for your dedication. You're a real pro.
(Heh, that went well.)
(We're out of options, Maya-chan! Foonyapar him!)

(Maya-chan said she didn't want to foonyapar unless she had
to. But that was unavoidable.)

Ah, you returned my serve, did you? Bravo. That takes a real
pro. Kudos for your dedication, Maya-chan!

(Maya-chan's looking more and more discouraged with each
foonyapar... Still, that one was unavoidable.)
...Uh, Maya-chan? It's okay, this is off the record.
Uh, er, um...

(I was too late. Maya-chan said she didn't want to foonyapar
unless she had to.)
Phew... That's one job down.
But we still have more to do. Okay, what's next?

Oh, right, you're going to be on Love to See You Smile.
Let's get you over to Soten TV.
Oh, right. Next up is the Princess League.
I'm sorry? I'm not scheduled to perform on Princess League.
Huh? You're not?
Um... Are you sure about this, Akiyama-san?
Oh, sorry, my mistake. So, uh, the next job should be...

You have to be in the studio for Sotenbori Love Check Quiz.
We'd better head over to Soten TV.
Welcome to "Love to See You Smile"! How is everybody doing?

(Love to See You Smile is a talk show. Maya-chan's really
going to need those cue cards to stay in character.)
I see, I see. But, I have to know⑬do you really have fans?

Ooh, oui, very much so. I enjoy the love and support of
everyone in the Strawberry Kingdom.

Let's set aside the kingdom of strawberries for a sec. How
about Osaka? Do you have fans in this neck of the woods?

Oui, oui, I am adored in Osaka, too. How dare you doubt me,
Nomu-san, pon!
(Okay. So far so good.)

Well, you'd be cute if you weren't babbling nonsense. Word of
advice: that bit about the Strawberry Kingdom isn't doing ya any favors.
Huh? It's not?

Of course it's not! When someone comes in with a weird
gimmick like that, it makes it hard to engage in banter.

If you ask me, Maya-chan, you oughta go to your agency and
talk it over with them. Maybe consider switching up your
brand a little, you know? Something proper!
Uh, but I...
(This calls for a cue card. But what should I write?)
(Okay, Maya-chan, look here. "I'll take it up with the agency.")
I... I'll discuss it with my agency.

Good! That's a smart decision. This bubbly, quirky
character... You're way out of your comfort zone, am I right?

No, I'm not trying to be something I'm not. But I could
probably appeal to a broader audience if I toned it down a
little...
Right? Then, let's make that change. How about it?
Um, er, well...
Oh, come on, that's not fair.
(Hmm... That didn't go well.)

(Okay, Maya-chan, look here. "The Strawberry Kingdom is
real, pon!")

The Strawberry Kingdom is real, pon! It's not some
made-up backstory, pon!

My, you're an obstinate one. Don't ya find it tiring to keep
up that quirky, perky charade day in, day out?
No, not at all. This is just who I am.

Please, you can't fool me. Even when you do that foonyapar
pose, your eyes tell me you can't stand it.

But, foonyapar is... uh... a standard greeting in the
Strawberry Kingdom. It would be silly for me to find it
humiliating...

Oh, come off it already. Incidentally, who thought up that
foonyapar thing anyway?
Who? Uh...

(Uh-oh! Time for another cue card! What do I write this
time?)

(I have to admit, the foonyapar thing's convenient. Even if
Maya-chan doesn't like doing it.)

Hm? What's wrong, Maya-chan? We're live on air. You have to
say something, ya know.
(Okay, Maya-chan, say this. "Why, me, of course, paloomp!")
Why, me, of course, paloomp!

I see. So you admit it's not a greeting from the Strawberry
Kingdom?

First, you said it was a greeting from the Strawberry
Kingdom, but now you say that you came up with it, paloomp.
(Oh, damn it! He's right. I screwed up...)
Whaddya say to that, Maya-chan?
Um, er, I...

(Ugh, that could've gone better. A talent has to stay in
character constantly or they'll lose credibility.)

(Okay, Maya-chan, try this. "It's the traditional Strawberry
greeting, pon!")

Foonyapar is the traditional greeting of the Strawberry
Kingdom, pon! Nobody thought it up, pon!
Okay, okay, you win, Princess! I'm waving the white flag!

(She did it! She managed to ride that out. We should be
okay now.)
This is Sotenbori Love Check Quiz!
Welcome to the show, Strawberry Maya-chan.

Maya-chan, you're well known for your quirky ways, but some
rumors say you're actually a quiet, serious, and relatively
ordinary person.

Oh, non, non, no! I am not quirky at all! I am the princess
of the Strawberry Kingdom!
Ah, please forgive me.
Now, let's begin, shall we?
It's time for Sotenbori Love Check Quiz!

(Okay, let's get the cue cards ready. For Maya-chan to stay
in character, she has to give the wrong answers. Meaning I
have to give her the wrong answers.)

Question one. Between Osaka Prefecture and Tokyo
Metropolis, Osaka is the bigger of the two. True or false?
(Maya-chan, say true!)
Incorrect.
(Maya-chan, say false!)
I'm going to say false.

Question two. Two times three times four times zero divided
by two equals zero. True or false?
I'll say true.
I believe it's false.
Question three. Dolphins are mammals. True or false?
Um... True?
This one's false.

Question four. Idol and idle. Both are people. True or
false?
Definitely true.
Definitely false.

Question five. The first computer ran on batteries. True or
false?
It must be true.
It must be false.

Question six. The final day of July is the thirty-first.
True or false?
